description: Wait for an email to arrive in a ZeroDrop inbox and return it with the OTP and magic link already extracted — no parsing needed. Blocks until an email matching the filters arrives or the timeout is reached. If ZeroDrop held the email instead (without an API key, one sender can reach only a few different inboxes a day), returns at once with error "held" and the reason. Use after triggering a signup, login, or password-reset flow.

from_contains.description: Only match emails whose sender contains this text

inbox.description: The inbox address (or name) returned by generate_inbox

require_magic_link.description: Only match emails with an extracted magic link

require_otp.description: Only match emails with an extracted OTP code

subject_contains.description: Only match emails whose subject contains this text

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait before giving up (default 30, max 120)

name: wait_for_email
